prompt: The JLabel shows 'null' instead of the user's name. Why?
choices: JLabel cannot display variables, only string literals
name is null — JLabel displays 'null' when given a null String
JLabel requires HTML format for text
explanation: JLabel(String) calls String.valueOf(null) which is the string "null". Fix: check if name is null before creating the label, or provide a default: new JLabel(name != null ? name : "Unknown").
